Replace values in a zutable

Source: R/replace.R
zutable-indexing.Rd

Replacing values (x$col <- v, x[["col"]] <- v, x[i, "col"] <- v) needs the column to exist and v to fit its type: exactly, or as a literal that is exactly representable there, such as 1 in an int32 column. Renaming, and assigning NULL, are zutable_schema_errors, so no replacement changes a table's schema. Selecting rows and columns by value is the bracket's: see zutable-bracket.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'zutable'
x$name <- value

# S3 method for class 'zutable'
x[[i, j]] <- value

# S3 method for class 'zutable'
x[i, j] <- value

Arguments

x

A zutable.

name, value

The column and its new values.

i, j

Rows and columns, as for a data frame.

Value

A zutable.

Examples

x <- zutable(id = 1:3, score = c(1.5, 2, 2.5))
x$id <- 7
x[2, "score"] <- 0
x
#> <zutable> 3 rows x 2 columns
#>   id      score
#>   <int32> <float64>
#> 1 7       1.5
#> 2 7       0.0
#> 3 7       2.5
x <- zutable(id = 1:3, score = c(1.5, 2, 2.5))
x[2:3, ]
#> <zutable> 2 rows x 2 columns
#>   id      score
#>   <int32> <float64>
#> 1 2       2.0
#> 2 3       2.5
x[, "score"]
#> <zutable> 3 rows x 1 column
#>   score
#>   <float64>
#> 1 1.5
#> 2 2.0
#> 3 2.5
x$id <- 7
x
#> <zutable> 3 rows x 2 columns
#>   id      score
#>   <int32> <float64>
#> 1 7       1.5
#> 2 7       2.0
#> 3 7       2.5
